title: Fade In
narration: The host gradually appears from transparent to fully visible.

title: Fade Out
narration: The host slowly disappears by reducing opacity.

title: Slide Left
narration: Slide the sprite smoothly toward the left side.

title: Slide Right
narration: Move the sprite across the screen to the right.

title: Slide Up
narration: Raise the sprite from below the frame.

title: Slide Down
narration: Lower the sprite into its final position.

title: Zoom In
narration: Bring the character closer by increasing its scale.

title: Zoom Out
narration: Make the character appear farther away.

title: Bounce
narration: A springy jump adds energy to entrances.

title: Rotate
narration: Rotate the character around its center.

title: Spin
narration: Spin continuously for a playful fast transition.

title: Flip X
narration: Mirror the sprite horizontally.

title: Flip Y
narration: Flip the sprite vertically.

title: Shake
narration: Rapid side-to-side movement communicates impact.

title: Wobble
narration: A swinging rotation creates a soft wobble.

title: Pulse
narration: A rhythmic scale change makes the character pulse.

title: Blink
narration: Briefly change opacity to create a blink.

title: Typewriter
narration: Reveal narration letters one at a time.

title: Pop Up
narration: Pop the character into view from below.

title: Elastic
narration: Stretch and settle back like elastic.

title: Glitch
narration: Offset colorful layers for a digital glitch.

title: VHS
narration: Add old tape scanlines and slight frame jitter.

title: RGB Split
narration: Separate cyan and magenta silhouettes.

title: Scanlines
narration: Overlay horizontal lines like an old monitor.

title: Pixelate
narration: Reduce the apparent detail to large pixels.

title: Mosaic
narration: Blur and block the sprite into larger tiles.

title: Motion Blur
narration: Create directional softness during movement.

title: Speed Ramp
narration: Change the speed from slow to fast and back.

title: Parallax
narration: Move background layers at different speeds.

title: Spotlight
narration: Isolate the character with a focused beam.

title: Sparkle
narration: Add twinkling highlights for a positive moment.

title: Smoke Puff
narration: Use expanding smoke clouds as a reveal.

title: Fireworks
narration: Finish with colorful fireworks and celebration.
